contentText: A new study of 235 donated NFL brains found CTE in 215 of them. Dr. Myron Rolle is a former college All-American and NFL player who is now a pediatric neurosurgeon. We ask him about his experience, his expertise and the advice he gives to parents when they ask if America's most popular pastime can still be made safe enough for our children. If you'd like to share your own great question, email us at greatquestion@cbsnews.com.
